name: Rust Floral A-Line Dress
reviews: Fabric looks like the photos and feels light for summer outings.
Runs slightly tight around the waist. Size up if between sizes.
Good for brunch or festive casual wear, but not very formal.
Color is accurate. Length is good for average height.
similar_buyer_notes: Buyers with past A-line purchases mostly kept size M
Often bought with tan sandals and oxidized earrings

name: White Chunky Sneakers
reviews: Looks premium for the price and goes with jeans.
Sole is slightly heavy for long walking days.
Size is mostly true, but wide feet may feel tight.
Easy to clean, but creases after repeated use.
return_notes: Fit returns higher for wide-foot users
similar_buyer_notes: Users who bought casual sneakers before kept this more often
Frequently compared with Puma and HRX white sneakers

name: Black Slim Fit Jeans
reviews: Denim quality is strong and does not fade quickly.
Slim fit is quite narrow around thighs.
Good stretch, but check waist size carefully.
Works well for office casual and weekend wear.
similar_buyer_notes: Buyers with prior Levis purchases usually choose same waist size

name: Emerald Embroidered Kurta
reviews: Embroidery looks elegant and close to catalog images.
Fabric is comfortable but slightly thin.
Good for small functions and festive office days.
Customer photos would help because catalog lighting is too polished.
return_notes: High keep rate for festive use
similar_buyer_notes: Users buying festive kurtas kept this item often

name: Beige Oversized Blazer
reviews: Looks structured and premium.
Oversized fit is intentional, not boxy if styled well.
Better for layering than hot weather.
Price feels high unless you need office or smart casual use.
similar_buyer_notes: Users who own trousers or formal shirts kept it more

reviews: Lightweight and good for running.
